programme.title: Survival Science S1 - "Surviving Treestand Accidents"
programme.desc: In this exciting episode we’ll find out the reasons why tree stand accidents happen and how we can prevent them. Cool science mixed with dynamic experiments send our hosts, our stunt team and our special crash test dummies plummeting to the ground.

programme.title: Survival Science S1 - "Sniper Attack"
programme.desc: Military snipers are trained in a variety of skills: detection, stalking, camouflage, infiltration, special reconnaissance and target acquisition. Bottom line, a ton of cool shooting and science for Nick and Laura to explore!

programme.title: Destruction Decoded S1 - "Megafloods"
programme.desc: Witness the devastating destructive power unleashed by planet earth’s most valuable resource – water.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded S1 - "Constructions"
programme.desc: Discover the worst bridge collapses and tunnel fires in history.

programme.title: The Demolition Man S1 - "Liverpool"
programme.desc: The sheer size of these buildings automatically makes this a very difficult job but these towers are also surrounded by hundreds of homes.

programme.title: The Demolition Man S1 - "Newcastle"
programme.desc: Taking down eight giant towers will take expert precision, planning & explosives. It’s imperative none of them fall in the wrong direction or fire any debris.

programme.title: The Demolition Man S1 - "City of London"
programme.desc: An asbestos ridden 1960s building in the crowded City of London is to be demolished to make way for a new hotel.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S3 - "Saving Private Terry"
programme.desc: Terry gets to relive part of his military carrier by attempting the famous sniper shot from Saving Private Ryan, and Larry and Terry demonstrate how sniper technology has developed over the years and test some amazing sniper shots.

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment S1 - "VANILLA"
programme.desc: In 1841 on the small island of Réunion, a 12-year-old slave did something no one had done before; artificially pollinate the vanilla plant. The vanilla bean took the world by storm, sparking the artificial flavor revolution and changing how we eat.

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment S1 - "WIFI"
programme.desc: Actress Hedy Lamarr, “the world's most beautiful woman,” had a knack for inventing. During WWII, in an effort to help the Allies, she devised a technology designed to intercept Axis communications – and created the foundation of wireless internet.

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment S1 - "STREAMING"
programme.desc: The early days of online video were plagued by low resolution and unbearable buffering times. But one day that all changed. In the late 90s, a breakthrough technology revolutionized streaming video, setting the foundation for the era of Netflix.

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment S1 - "INTERSTATE"
programme.desc: Dwight Eisenhower’s interstate highway system was the biggest infrastructure project of its time, a bold plan to connect all corners of America and boost the economy. So how did it end up deepening the divide between rich and poor?

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment S1 - "EDISON"
programme.desc: Edison pioneered the world’s first research and development center in Menlo Park, New Jersey, working with a group of experimenters to methodically zero in on the holy grail of electric light.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S1 - "Roads That Changed The World"
programme.desc: Chariots were the express vehicles of their day – but how did they work? And what about the roads, tunnels, and bridges that they relied upon?

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S1 - "The Great Wall of China"
programme.desc: Since the earliest civilizations, humans have needed walls to protect them.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S1 - "Secrets Of The Pyramids"
programme.desc: The Great Pyramid at Giza is the only survivor of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. Its scale is breath-taking and it is built to precision.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S1 - "Rise Of The Super-Castle"
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, the technology of the castle evolved by leaps and bounds.

programme.title: Trajectory S1 - "Chasing a Comet"
programme.desc: COLD WAR & THE START OF THE SPACE RACE – Cold War rivalry and the acceleration of space exploration. SERVICING HUBBLE - Preparations for Hubble’s final servicing mission. CHASING A COMET - Launch and the difficult path to rendezvous.

programme.title: Trajectory S1 - "Mars Express"
programme.desc: PROJECT MERCURY BEGINS - The start of NASA & America’s first manned space program. MARS EXPRESS - The European Space Agency’s Mars Satellite. THE SOYUZ LAUNCH SYSTEM - The gradual evolution of Russia’s Soyuz launcher.

programme.title: Trajectory S1 - "Mercury Advances"
programme.desc: PROJECT MERCURY ADVANCES - America’s first manned space program finally puts a man in orbit. CAMERA TRACKING - The array of special cameras that follow a spacecraft at launch.

programme.title: Trajectory S1 - "Venus Express"
programme.desc: PROJECT GEMINI COMMENCES - Did Gemini give the US a lead in the space race? VENUS EXPRESS - The last days of ESA’s Venus probe. EMU NASA’s - Extravehicular Mobility Unit. DEEP SPACE COMMUNICATIONS - ESA’s worldwide network of giant dishes.

programme.title: Trajectory S1 - "More about Mars"
programme.desc: PROJECT GEMINI ADVANCES - NASA refines the techniques needed for rendezvous. CASSINI AT SATURN - In the Cassini probe’s final years of activity, its handlers are asking it to do more complex and risky assignments.

programme.title: Trajectory S1 - "Swarm"
programme.desc: PROJECT GEMINI DOCKING AND EVA - In the final phase of the Gemini program NASA struggles with docking and spacewalks. CURIOUSITY ROVING MARS - On the surface of Mars the Curiousity rover is changing the way we think about the red planet.

programme.title: Engineering the Future S2 - "The Race to Space"
programme.desc: A new era of space, where small satellites no bigger than a showbox will be deployed not in one or twos, but in their thousands, referred to as satellite swarms.

programme.title: Engineering the Future S2 - "Perpetual Power"
programme.desc: All over the world, engineers and scientists are racing to solve one key problem: how to safely and efficiently store electricity at a huge scale but at a low cost.

programme.title: Engineering the Future S2 - "Timber Skyscraper"
programme.desc: This film explores the mind-blowing world of timber buildings for a more sustainable future.

programme.title: Digits S1 - "Connecting to the Future"
programme.desc: Muller escorts viewers to the physical heart of the Internet, revealing the very first message sent by UCLA professor Leonard Kleinrock, and demonstrating how Internet co-creators Vint Cerf and Bob Kahn devised a common protocol language.

programme.title: Digits S1 - "Man vs. Machine"
programme.desc: Get a sneak peek into how the Internet of Things will soon dominate daily life. As Edward Snowden provocatively points out, “TV is a medium that you watch. The Internet is a medium that watches you as you watch it.”

programme.title: Digits S1 - "Guardians of the Web"
programme.desc: Explore how our reliance on the web creates vulnerability to everything from cyber theft to an Internet system failure. Muller introduces viewers to “white hat” hackers, the U.S. Secret Service’s cybercrime division and even West Point soldiers.

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Yanukovych's Hidden Palace"
programme.desc: Having stolen billions from the populace, Ukrainian dictator Viktor Yanukovych hides his treasure trove in a mind-bending corruption scheme that leads to Mezhyhirya, a 150-acre estate, with secret underground tunnels.

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Ceausescu's Delusions of Grandeur"
programme.desc: Casa Poporlui is the magnum opus of Romania’s most bloodthirsty dictator, Nicolae Ceausescu, and hides secrets of an extensive underground bunker system.

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "The Best Of"
programme.desc: Travel across the continent, exploring the opulent villas, luxurious palaces, remote command centers, underground tunnels, and secret bunkers of Europe’s most tyrannical dictators.

programme.title: Health Explored S1 - "Human Performance"
programme.desc: How is it that some people have been able to reach the pinnacle of our human performance? Guided by Dr. David Behm, an expert in sports physiology, we uncover the fascinating intersection of science and athletic performance.
